MUS.note: No national digital strategy is named.

facts.fact: Minister Avinash Ramtohul says amendments to the Electronic Transactions Act 2006 have modernised the framework for digital commerce, with a reliability-based standard for electronic signatures, recognition of automated contracting and electronic transferable records; a Consumers Protection Act amendment on electronic transactions is still to come.
Minister Avinash Ramtohul recalls that Mauritius has adopted the ISO/IEC 27001 information security standard and urges Mauritius Post Ltd to implement it.

MUS.note: The adopting standards body is not named.

facts.fact: Minister Avinash Ramtohul says Mauritius has adopted the ISO/IEC 27001 information security standard; no standards body is named.

MUS.note: No certification against it is stated.
